items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: Ronnie Cole and Ronnie was very nice about it you know he tried to do see at that time Ronnie was running the little club behind the Absinthe Board there either part of the Absinthe Board for a while so uh I went in I got a drink... that was my first encounter

ctx.x: what was I mean okay you couldn't go to the quarter I mean the club owners made it known that they didn't they didn't want blacks

that's right they made it known uh and then some of them did not but I tell you what broke up the French Quarter uh uh what made blacks started going to French Quarter uh Bill what is Bill's last name oh god dang it's on the tip of my tongue very good friend of mine and he loved Henry Desjua in fact uh the first time I really wanted to go into a club uh Alan Toussaint and myself was standing on ramp or uh standing down on Berber Street and up comes uh the piano player guy he's still playing he used to own a club…
